messages:
ana: Dropping a quick thread on the rollout timeline inspector mock I uploaded. Main trade: lightweight hover preview vs explicit open for keyboard/touch. Comments?

mike: Love the compact approach. Two quick product notes: 1) people mix up allocation numbers with version ids in narrow panes, 2) rollback needs to be reachable but safe.

sam: Tech: easiest is two-layer behavior. CSS-only transient preview for mouse (no focus), and a JS-controlled persistent inspector on click/Enter. Use aria-expanded on the node when persistent.

yvonne: Accessibility: don't rely on hover-only tooltips. Each chip needs an aria-describedby that points to an offscreen description like "Canary variant 612; serving five percent of traffic". Also the pill contrast is ~3.2:1 now; bump to 4.5:1 or treat as large text.

jules: Copy suggestion: change allocation pill to "Canary 612; 5% of traffic" and append a short version token like "· v42" to avoid confusion with version numbers.

ana: Keyboard flow proposal: Tab lands on the version node, Enter opens the persistent inspector (role=region/dialog-like), inside arrow keys move between chips, Space expands chip details. Hover still shows a quick preview for mouse. On touch, disable preview and rely on tap.

mike: UX decision: show a subtle inline "Revert" (ghost icon + label) inside the inspector that opens a confirmation modal. No destructive single-clicks.

sam: Small CSS example for preview:```css
.rollout-node .preview{ transform:translateY(-6px); opacity:0; transition:opacity .12s, transform .12s }
.rollout-node:hover .preview{ opacity:1; transform:translateY(0) }
``` Use :focus-within to mirror preview for keyboard but only if the node itself is focused.

yvonne: Motion/timeout: add ~200ms hide delay before preview disappears so folks with motor difficulties can move pointer in. For keyboard, don't auto-expand on focus; require Enter to open persistent inspector.

jules: On small screens reduce chip horizontal padding by 2px to avoid wrapping but keep touch target >=44px. Also add a faint divider between timeline rows for scanning.

deploy-bot: heads-up: feature flag `compact-rollout-inspector` enabled in staging tomorrow 15:00 UTC. Watch logs: /deploys/rollout-inspector. :rocket:

ana: I'll update Figma frames and post a short engineering checklist: 1) hover preview CSS + 200ms hide delay, 2) Enter toggles persistent inspector (set aria-expanded), 3) arrow key nav inside inspector, 4) sr-only descriptions for pills, 5) Revert opens confirmation modal (role=dialog with aria-labelledby + aria-describedby), 6) change microcopy to "Canary 612; 5% of traffic · v42", 7) color contrast and padding fixes, 8) disable preview on touch.

mike: Sounds good. Close this thread once the PR links to the checklist and accessibility notes. :thumbsup:
